recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No source follow-up is needed for FHIR-13586 unless the work group later reopens the broader Appointment-to-iCalendar mapping design.
issue_request: FHIR-13586 was a Published Patient Administration change request for STU3 Appointment mappings to iCalendar. The accepted Persuasive with Modification resolution was to include the requested iCalendar mappings for Appointment except the trailing requestedPeriod/free-busy item.
initial_application: The change appears to have been applied in legacy source by commit 87ce43db922810cf7461a4b098916209234ae0be, whose subject includes "GF#13586 Appointment iCal mapping updates". That commit updated source/appointment/appointment-spreadsheet.xml with the accepted iCalendar mapping rows before the Appointment source was migrated to the current StructureDefinition XML format.
additional_context: Appointment is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini, and the iCalendar mapping space is published in source/mappingSpaces.xml. The current source/appointment/structuredefinition-Appointment.xml contains all accepted FHIR-13586 mappings and has no iCalendar mapping on Appointment.requestedPeriod. Jira and community searches did not find a later or conflicting decision for this narrow mapping request.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch documenting that the current authoritative Appointment source already matches the Jira resolution.
